newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London hit by Intel warning.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London hit by Intel warning.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London weakened on Friday following a profit warning by U.S.technology bellwether Intel Corp with high-tech stocks bearing the brunt of the fall, dealers said.
Intel warned its second quarter profits would be below expectations as demand was weaker-than-projected.
"Anything connected to Intel's business got a smack this afternoon," said one dealer.

Casualties from the mark-down in high-tech shares included TDK Corporation which dropped 18 yen to 8,922 yen, NEC Corporation falling 27 yen to 1,593 yen and Pioneer Electronics which eased 39 yen to 2,841 yen.
The Nikkei 50 Index fell 0.36 of a point to close at 1,559.06 after being around 10 points higher in morning trade.
